labels.text: Section 7345(b)(1)(B) as adjusted under section 7345(f): the dollar amount above which an unpaid, legally enforceable Federal tax liability is a seriously delinquent tax debt. Only the published figures of the Revenue Procedures pinned in `us.irc.inflation_adjustments` are recorded (2025: Rev. Proc. 2024-40; 2026: Rev. Proc. 2025-32); other years are outside the declared coverage, so evaluation gives no value rather than an unsourced figure. See TECH-GAPS.md G5640.
Rev. Proc. 2024-40 section 2.60: for calendar year 2025 the section 7345(b)(1)(B) amount is $64,000
Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.60: for calendar year 2026 the section 7345(b)(1)(B) amount is $66,000
